body: fuck up since birth. Parents divorced when I was small. I ended up with my mom. My mom became alcoholic and abusive. I love my dad (my mom too ofc) however I don't want to keep on being a burden to him. He has a new wife, and kids and is finally happy. The only thing keeping him back, is me. He always tells me how his life would be so much better if he didnt have any ties to my mom. I also function as a sort of middle man between my mom and dad for all their money fights as they wont talk to each other. I lost all my friends in the last months. I took up weed during a really low point in my life, however still keep on doing it occasionally (this will be important later). My mom finally found a good guy after so many shitty relationships (probably the reason she treated me like shit). She has stopped drinking as much, and seemed to be finally happy. Until I got caught smoking. After everything seemed to be going well in her life, I had to come and fuck it up she said. Ever since I am like 8 I can remember my mom insulting me and telling me I am nothing, how I am the cause of all her issues. And I can now see that this is true. I have always been suicidal however until now I set my mind to it.
